description: Adds a Location source choice to the Customization screen: Android's own location providers, microG's (microg Services) or Google Play services' fused provider. With Android, neither is ever asked for a location. A source that is missing or disabled is never used, so location keeps working without it. Also keeps the network (Wi-Fi/cell) provider registered when no fused provider answers, instead of GPS only, so a fix does not go stale indoors.
name: Location provider toggle

options.description: The location source Maps starts with. On: the fused provider -- Google Play services', or microG's in microG Maps -- whenever it is installed and enabled, Android's own providers otherwise. Off: Android's own providers. Can be changed later on the Customization screen.
options.title: Default to Play services location

description: Brings the Pixel-only power saving mode to every phone: while driving with navigation, press the power button and Maps shows only key information such as the next turn on a black screen. Turn it on or off in Settings > Navigation > Power saving mode. Pixels that have it built in keep Google's own version unless Power saving mode is turned on in Power Saving Options, a row on the account sheet under Customization, which also has: a navigation button that opens the power saving screen without locking the phone, switching to it by itself when idle, a speedometer on it, a lower frame rate, and its black map in navigation or all over Maps.
name: Power saving mode

description: Removes permissions that only serve Google-account features or Google's data collection: background location, physical activity, contacts, microphone (voice search stops working), camera (Lens and Live View stop working), car speed, advertising ID, push messages and Google services settings. Left out with Add microG support, whose account features need them.
name: Remove permissions

description: Points the Firebase Installations and Play services compliance check-ins at an unresolvable host, stops every ad impression and click ping from being sent, and deregisters Google's logging, performance-monitoring, survey and Location History libraries and the on-device federated-learning services.
name: Remove telemetry

description: Lets a re-signed Maps load tiles, search and routing, by sending Google's own package and certificate.
name: Restore map data

description: Swaps Facebook's blue on links, buttons, switches and the selected tab for a color you like better. Nothing changes until you pick one. Pick a color in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.
name: Accent color

description: Lets you take screenshots and screen recordings on the pages where Facebook blocks them, so you can keep a copy of what's on screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.
name: Allow screenshots

description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black, or a dark color you pick, instead of dark gray, which can save battery on OLED screens. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first. It isn't selected by default because undoing it means patching again. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.
name: AMOLED black theme

options.description: The color dark mode's backgrounds use, as a six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #0D1117. Leave it blank for black. Cards and inputs get a slightly lighter shade. Grays up to about #535353 work, and lighter colors are refused so text stays readable.
options.title: Background color

description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install after seeing ads, and stops several of the ways it sends your phone's advertising ID, so less of what you do feeds its ad tracking. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Block ad telemetry

description: Stops Facebook downloading ads and ad data in the background before you ever see them, which saves mobile data and battery. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Block background ad prefetch

description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to Facebook within ten minutes, or any time with No time limit on, so you don't lose what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.
name: Block background-return feed refresh

description: Games you play inside Facebook show no ads, so you can keep playing without breaks. A rewarded ad gives no reward unless you also turn on the switch that counts it as watched. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Menu.
name: Block Instant Games ads

description: Blocks the kinds of notification you pick, such as trending videos, memories and birthdays, so you get fewer pings you don't care about. Messages, friend requests, comments and login alerts always come through. Starts off. Turn on the kinds you want in Hushfacebook settings > Notifications.
name: Block promotional notifications

description: Stops Facebook noticing when you take a screenshot or record the screen, in the feed, Reels, chats and everywhere else, so it can't react to it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.
name: Block screenshot detection

description: Tidies Chats inside Facebook. One switch empties the row of notes and who's active above your chats, and another removes promotional banners like the one asking you to turn on notifications. Your chats stay. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Chats.
name: Clean up Facebook's chat list

description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
name: Clean up Reels

description: Small fixes for comments. Stop a long press on Like from opening reactions, hide the GIF and sticker buttons, show every reply without tapping View replies, hide Related groups under group posts, and hide comments with shop links or your words. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Comments.
name: Comment sheet options

description: Opens comments in the order you choose, Most relevant, Newest or All comments, instead of the one Facebook picks. Handy if you always want the newest first. Starts off. Turn it on and pick an order in Hushfacebook settings > Comments.
name: Default comment order

description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of what Facebook picks. Lower saves data, higher looks sharper. Starts off. Turn it on and pick a quality in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.
name: Default playback quality

description: Stops Facebook serving its ads inside other apps on your phone. Those apps show their own ads or none, and their rewarded ads may fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Disable Audience Network

description: Stops Google Play offering Facebook updates, which a patched app can't take anyway. It isn't selected by default because once it's installed, a build without it can't install over it. It doesn't work on a Root Mount install. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.
name: Disable Play Store updates

description: Stops sending Facebook the list of reels you've watched, so it learns less about what you watch. Reels you've already seen may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
name: Don't send reel watch history

description: Shows Save photo on every photo you open, even where the poster turned saving off, and saves the largest size so you get the best copy. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.
name: Download any photo

description: Adds a Download button beside every reel and a Download row to its More menu, so you can keep reels on your phone. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
name: Download any reel

description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music, so you can keep the ones you like. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.
name: Download any story

description: Adds Download to phone to the menu of videos in the feed and in Watch, so you can save them to watch later. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.
name: Download any video

description: Makes Home show the newest posts from the friends, groups and Pages you follow instead of Facebook's ranked feed, so you see what they posted rather than what Facebook picks. Home shows, right below it, narrows Home to one of the Feeds tab's filters (Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages). Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.
name: Following feed on Home

description: Keeps Facebook in dark mode whatever its own setting says. Useful on tablets, where Facebook's settings have no Dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.
name: Force dark mode

description: With a reel or video paused, a tap on its right side steps one frame forward and a tap on its left side one frame back, so you can stop on the exact moment you want. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.
name: Frame step

description: Removes the shopping cards that affiliate links add to reels, feed posts and comments, plus Shop now cards on reels, so you see fewer sales pitches while you scroll. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.
name: Hide affiliate product links

description: Removes posts and reels Facebook marked as made with AI, posts creators labeled as AI, posts with Meta's AI characters and Meta AI cards in the feed. Only the Meta AI cards switch starts on. Change them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed and Reels and Watch.
name: Hide AI-detected posts

description: Hides the Upgrades and Also from Meta sections and the Muse card in Facebook's Menu, so the Menu has fewer ads for Meta's products. Settings, Help and your shortcuts stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Menu.
name: Hide Menu promotions

description: Removes Meta AI's summary of the comments from the top of the comment sheet and from under posts, so you read what people actually wrote. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments.
name: Hide Meta AI comment summaries

description: Removes the Meta AI answer and Ask Meta AI prompts from search results, and stops suggestions from sending your search to Meta AI. You get plain results for people, groups, Pages and posts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.
name: Hide Meta AI in search

description: Removes the row of Meta AI questions Facebook adds under some posts, for a cleaner feed. The post and its buttons stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.
name: Hide Meta AI questions under posts

description: Hides Meta's pushes for its other products, such as Edits, Threads cross-posting, Meta Verified, avatar stickers and Meta AI's Imagine, so you see fewer sales pitches. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Meta's other products.
name: Hide Meta upsells

description: Removes the strip Facebook adds to some posts, like "Are you interested in this post?", "Show less" or follow suggestions, so posts look less cluttered. No gap is left. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed. A second switch there, Hide the Follow link on posts, starts off.
name: Hide post prompts

description: Hides feed posts with words you list, or from people, Pages or sites you list, so you skip topics you're tired of. Photo, video, link and colored background posts can go too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.
name: Hide posts by words

description: People you chat with in chats that open inside Facebook don't see that you've read their messages, so you can read now and reply later. Replying may still show you've read it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.
name: Hide read receipts

description: Removes the "Are you interested in this reel?" prompt, so reels play without the interruption. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
name: Hide reel interest prompts

description: Removes the rows of reels between posts and the reels Facebook adds where your feed ends, so the feed sticks to posts. A reel a friend posts stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.
name: Hide Reels in the feed

description: Keeps posts you've already scrolled past out of the feed when it loads again, for 1, 3, 7 or 30 days, so you see something new. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.
name: Hide seen posts

description: Removes ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed and search results, so you see more of what people are selling. Listings people post stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.
name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings

description: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind, so you see fewer ads. It also keeps the floating ad button off an ad's comments. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.
name: Hide sponsored posts

description: Removes the ads between posts on someone's profile or a Page, so you only see what they posted. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.
name: Hide sponsored profile posts

description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over reels and ads in the middle of videos, so you can watch without interruptions. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
name: Hide sponsored reels

description: Removes the ads from Facebook's search results, so you see the people, Pages and posts you searched for. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.
name: Hide sponsored search results

description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories shows only what people posted. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.
name: Hide sponsored stories

description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the feed, the stories between posts, or the "What's on your mind?" row at the top of Home, so you reach posts sooner. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.
name: Hide Stories tray

description: Removes what Facebook adds to the feed besides ads, like "Suggested for you" posts, "People you may know" and suggested groups, so you see more from people you follow. Most of its switches are on by default. Change them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.
name: Hide suggested and promoted posts

description: Removes stories Facebook suggests from people and Pages you don't follow, and the "Find friends from contacts" card, so the Stories tray sticks to people you know. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.
name: Hide suggested stories

description: Takes the dot and count off the tabs you pick, and Facebook's count off its app icon, so the app nags you less. Notifications still arrive and still show in the Notifications tab. Starts off. Turn on the ones you want in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.
name: Hide tab badges

description: Takes the tabs you pick off the tab bar, such as Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming or Events, so the bar only has what you use. Each page stays in the Menu. Starts off. Turn on the ones you want in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.
name: Hide tabs

description: Takes the title row and the All, Favorites, Friends, Groups and Pages filters off the top of the Feeds tab, so it opens straight on posts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, then restart Facebook.
name: Hide the Feeds header

description: Hides the "Get the Messenger app" card at the top of Chats when Messenger is already installed. A patched Facebook may not see that Messenger is there, so it keeps showing the card. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Chats.
name: Hide the Get Messenger card

description: Takes the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts, off the tab bar, so Reels isn't one tap away. Reels in your feed and reel links still open. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch, then restart Facebook.
name: Hide the Reels tab

description: Takes the new-item dot and count off the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts, so it stops calling for your attention. Other tabs keep theirs. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
name: Hide the Reels tab dot

description: Others don't see that you're typing, in chats that open inside Facebook and in comment boxes, so you can write without anyone watching. Your messages send as usual. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.
name: Hide typing indicator

description: Hold a reel to play it at double speed, and let go to go back to normal. Handy for skimming. The reel's more button still opens Facebook's long-press menu. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
name: Hold a reel for 2x

description: Stops Facebook sending its usage reports in the background and skips the learning jobs it runs on your phone, so less about how you use the app leaves it. A second switch holds back the camera roll processing that uploads your photos and details about them for sharing suggestions. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy, then restart Facebook.
name: Hold back analytics uploads

description: Adds a Hushfacebook settings row to Facebook's Menu, at the end of Settings and privacy, so the settings are easy to find. A Saved row joins it while the Saved shortcut switch is on, and a Watch history row while the Watch history shortcut switch is. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Hushfacebook in the Menu

description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook, where you turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook and back up your choices. To open them, long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed or Facebook's app icon. Other patches need it, so keep it selected.
name: Hushfacebook settings

description: Lets the official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace install next to your patched Facebook. Without it, Android refuses them because they share two permissions with Facebook. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Install beside Meta's apps

description: Keeps the date under the poster's name, so you can always tell how old a post is. Facebook's newer header can swap it for rotating details, and on some phones the line goes blank. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.
name: Keep post dates

description: Keeps every reel's progress bar full size and moving smoothly, with the time above it, so you can drag it without tapping first. Also keeps a full-screen video's controls on screen until you tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.
name: Keep the progress bar

description: A speed you pick in a reel's menu stays for the next reels until Facebook restarts, so you don't set it every time. On by default. A second switch for feed and Watch videos starts off. Both are in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
name: Keep the reel speed

description: Turns Facebook into a Marketplace app for buying and selling without the feed. The tab bar keeps only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu, and Facebook opens on Marketplace. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook, then restart Facebook.
name: Marketplace only

description: Gives Facebook's dark mode the colors of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, so it matches your phone. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first. It isn't selected by default because undoing it means patching again. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.
name: Material You theme

description: Opens web links in your own browser instead of Facebook's built-in one, without Facebook tracking the click. Facebook pages still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Links. A second switch, on by default under Privacy, stops Facebook's browser keeping a history of the links you open in it.
name: Open links in external browser

description: Makes the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats, if you'd rather chat in Messenger. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats.
name: Open Messenger from the top bar

description: Opens Facebook on the tab you pick when you start it from its icon, so you can skip the feed. It's Marketplace unless you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.
name: Open on a chosen tab

description: Keeps reels and videos from the Reels and Video tabs, or full screen, playing in a small window when you leave Facebook, so you can watch while using another app. Needs Android 12 or later. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.
name: Picture-in-picture

description: Fixes profiles, photos, posts and some Settings pages that won't open on a patched Facebook, and lets a Messenger or Facebook Lite patched in the same Manager sign in through it. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Restore screens on re-signed builds

description: A video longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time it plays, in the feed or full screen, so you don't lose your place. Reels, live videos and ads start as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.
name: Resume long videos

description: Takes Facebook's tracking tags off links you share or copy, so you share a clean link. A facebook.com/share/ link is made for one share, so Facebook can still trace that kind back to you, and a switch that starts off shares the post's own link in its place. On by default. Both are in Hushfacebook settings > Links.
name: Sanitize sharing links

description: Photos and videos you send from chats that open inside Facebook go out as the originals instead of smaller copies, so they arrive sharp. Very large files are still shrunk. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats.
name: Send chat photos and videos at original quality

description: Lets you hide items you never use from Facebook's share sheet, such as WhatsApp, Meta AI or Copy link, so the ones you want are easier to reach. Nothing is hidden until you pick. Choose them in Hushfacebook settings > Links, where a switch that starts off also takes away the buttons that send to the people you picked as a new group chat.
name: Share sheet items

description: Adds View profile to every seller's Marketplace page. It opens their regular Facebook profile, so you can check who you're buying from. Facebook shows that button to only some accounts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.
name: Show View profile on Marketplace sellers

description: Stops Facebook crashing or freezing at start on x86 devices, such as computer emulators and x86 Chromebooks. Most phones and tablets don't need it, and it doesn't change how they start. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Start on x86 devices

description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe, so you can take your time with it. A second switch replays a finished story from the start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.
name: Stop Story auto-advance

description: Stops Facebook asking you to update, since a patched app can't install Meta's updates anyway. Meta App Manager's update prompts and chat prompts aimed at older versions go too. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Updates.
name: Stop update prompts

description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. A second switch lets it slide away as you scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.
name: Tab bar at the bottom

description: Stops Facebook offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments, so names don't pop up in your way. Typing @ still brings up the list. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Writing.
name: Tag suggestions only after @

description: Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, so nothing plays until you want it to. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.
name: Tap to play

description: Shows posts and reel captions in the language they were written in, instead of Facebook's automatic translation, so you read people's own words. See translation still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.
name: Turn off auto-translation

description: Stops a double tap on a reel or video from liking it, so you don't like things by accident. A single tap still plays or pauses, and the Like button still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
name: Turn off double tap to like

description: Stops the short vibrations Facebook plays when you tap and swipe in it, if you find them distracting. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.
name: Turn off haptics

description: Stops HDR videos and photos from turning your screen up to full brightness, which can be harsh in the dark. They keep their resolution. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.
name: Turn off HDR brightness

description: Shows Facebook's tabs, Menu and new screens at once, without the slide between them, so the app feels quicker. Swipes and animations inside a page stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.
name: Turn off screen transitions

description: Lets you pick the app icons Facebook keeps for Facebook Plus on its App icon page (Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon), so your home screen icon can be any of them. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.
name: Unlock app icons

description: Draws emoji with your phone's own emoji font instead of Meta's, so emoji in posts, comments and chats match your keyboard. Reactions and stickers stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.
name: Use the phone's emoji

description: Draws Facebook's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a font file you pick, so Facebook matches the rest of your phone. Icons and emoji keep their own. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.
name: Use the system font

description: Lifts the 60 Hz limit Maps puts on itself, on the app and on the map, so it can run at your screen's full refresh rate (such as 120 Hz). Uses more battery, most of all while navigating. Off by default: switch it on on the Customization screen.
name: 120 refresh rate

description: Adds a 2D / 3D compass switch to the Experimental screen. With it on, tapping the compass in navigate mode switches the map between the tilted 3D view and a flat, north-up 2D map the way Google Maps' does, from any state (following you, panned away, paused), and brings the map back to you. The compass shows a single north arrow in 2D, and the next navigation starts in the mode you used last.
name: 2D / 3D compass

description: Removes the "More from this app" label from the account sheet, and keeps the sheet open when you come back from Settings or Customization or tap "Your profile", instead of dropping back to the map.
name: Account sheet cleanup

description: Builds microG Maps, a separate app (org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps.microg) that signs in to your Google account through microG: saved places and lists, Timeline, location sharing, contributions and push messages. Remove sign-in prompts, Trim account menu and Remove permissions are left out of this build, Offline saved places keeps only its Local saved screen, which copies your account's saved lists to the phone (Pull from Google account), and its icon carries microG's C. Needs microG: MicroG-RE or ReVanced GmsCore. Not for root (mount) installs.
name: Add microG support

description: How far ahead, in metres, Waze warns of police, hazards, crashes, traffic jams and speed cameras. The defaults are the old Waze mods' (CGE); Waze's own are lower for most of them.
name: Alert distances

description: Every mood can be chosen: the ones Waze keeps for higher ranks and the beta moods it hides.
name: All moods

description: Navigation's Default media app (Settings > Navigation) offers every music and podcast app that works with Android Auto, such as Poweramp, not only Spotify, YouTube Music and Pandora.
name: Any media app

description: Adds a Better filters switch to the Experimental screen. With it on, the trail filter's sliders move in finer steps over the same ranges: Rating in 0.1 stars (instead of Any, 3.5, 4 and 4.5), Length in 0.1 mi, Elevation gain in 10 ft, Highest point in 100 ft and Distance away in 1 mi (metric: 0.1 km, 5 m, 50 m, 1 km).
name: Better filters
